SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 02 and 03
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 02:30:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

WITH RankedSecurities AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM reference.scd_securities
    WHERE business_date = '2025-06-11'
)
select a.*, b.*, c.*, d.country_name, e.currency_name, f.*, p.*, g.*, h.*, i.*
From 	
(
  select
    ss.model_portfolio_id as id_model_portfolio,
    ss.portfolio_id as id_portfolio,
    ss.cppib_sec_id as id_instrument_new,
    'CPPIBSEC_ID' as instrument_id_type,
    ss.scd_holding_key_id id_source_holding,
	null as id_enterprise_holding,
    sec.abor_security_group_id as instrument_sub_group_code,
    sec.abor_security_group_name as instrument_sub_group_name,
    ss.abor_security_type_id as instrument_type_code,
    ss.abor_security_type_name as instrument_type_name,
    ss.abor_security_name as instrument_name_source,
    ss.balance_nominal_number as current_nominal,
    ss.balance_nominal_number * ss.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as current_nominal_pc,
    ss.clean_price as current_clean_price,
    ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as clean_market_value,
    ss.balance_book_value_quotation_currency as book_value,
    ss.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency as cost_value,
    ss.accrued_interest_quotation_currency as current_accrued_amount,
    ss.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,
    ss.clean_value_portfolio_currency as clean_market_value_pc,
    ss.balance_book_value_portfolio_currency as cost_value_pc,
    ss.accrued_interest_end_of_period_portfolio_currency as current_accrued_amount_pc,	
    sec.abor_quote_factor as quote_factor,
    sec.abor_quote_type as quote_type_description,
    ss.next_coupon_date as next_coupon_date_source,
    '2025-06-11' as business_date,
    ss.accrued_interest_end_of_period_portfolio_currency as abacus_accrued_interest_pc,
    ss.accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency as abacus_accrued_interest_qc,
    ss.quotation_currency_code as current_notional_currency,
    ss.quotation_currency_code as market_value_currency,
    ss.quotation_currency_code as quoted_currency_code
  from holdings.scd_holdings_main ss
  left join RankedSecurities sec
	 on ss.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
  where ss.clean_value_quotation_currency != 0
    and ss.business_date = '2025-06-11'  
    and ((sec.abor_security_group_id in ('ABCP') and ss.abor_security_type_id in ('ABCP'))
      or (sec.abor_security_group_id in ('CP') and ss.abor_security_type_id in ('TD','BA','BD','CP','GOVTB'))
      or (sec.abor_security_group_id in ('CPPIBCPIS') and ss.abor_security_type_id in ('CPPIBCPIS'))
      or (sec.abor_security_group_id in ('CPPIBCP') and ss.abor_security_type_id in ('CPPIBCP'))
    )
) as a
left Join
(
  select
    CAST(cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_sec_id_new,
    cusip,
    isin,
    issue_date,
    document_type,
    instrument_description,
    bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange,
    bloomberg_unique_id,
    bloomberg_exchange,
    sedol,
    ticker,
    exchange_name,
    mic,
    region_code,
    market_sector_description,
    issue_country_iso,
    coupon_rate,
    coupon_type,
    par_amount,
    issue_price,
    first_coupon_date,
    next_coupon_date,
    maturity_date,
    callable_flag,
    null as putable_flag,
    null as sinkable_flag,
    null as convertible_flag,
    null as junior_flag,
    null as senior_flag,
    null as collateral_type,
    country_code as mds_country_code,
    cast(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id_new,
    coupon_frequency_code,
    delete_date
    --coupon_frequency_unit_source
  FROM asset.asset_money_market
  where business_date = date'2025-06-11'

  union all

  select
    CAST(cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_sec_id_new,
    cusip,
    isin,
    CAST(issue_date AS VARCHAR) as issue_date,
    document_type,
    instrument_description,
    bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange,
    bloomberg_unique_id,
    bloomberg_exchange,
    sedol,
    ticker,
    exchange_name,
    mic,
    region_code,
    market_sector_description,
    issue_country_iso,
    coupon_rate ,	
    coupon_type ,	
    par_amount,
    issue_price,
    first_coupon_date,
    next_coupon_date,
    maturity_date,
    callable_flag,
    putable_flag,
    sinkable_flag,
    convertible_flag,
    junior_flag,
    senior_flag,
    collateral_type,
    country_code as mds_country_code,
    cast(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id_new,
    coupon_frequency_code,
    cast(delete_date AS VARCHAR) as delete_date
  FROM asset.asset_bonds
  where business_date = date'2025-06-11'
) as b
  on a.id_instrument_new=b.cppib_sec_id_new
left join
(
  select
    CAST(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id_new3,
    party_name, 
    bloomberg_company_id, 
    incorp_country_code,
    domicile_country_code
  FROM party.party
  where business_date = date'2025-06-11'
) as p
  on b.cppib_party_id_new=p.cppib_party_id_new3
left join	
(
  select	
    CAST(cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_sec_id_new2,	
    cppib_country_of_exposure_code ,	
    cppib_currency_code ,	
    cppib_currency_of_exposure_code	
  FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications
  where business_date = date'2025-06-11'
) as c	
  on b.cppib_sec_id_new=c.cppib_sec_id_new2	
left join	
(
  select	
    country_code,	
    country_name	
  FROM reference.reference_country_codes
  where business_date = date'2025-06-11'

  on c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code=d.country_code	
left join	
(

  where business_date = date'2025-06-11'

    unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
  FROM finance_accounting.model_portfolios
  where business_date = date'2025-06-11'

  on a.id_model_portfolio = f.id_model_portfolio

(
  select

    rating_value as inst_final_rating
  FROM radar_reporting_prod.cppib_security_rating
  where business_date = '2025-06-11'
    and rating_agency = 'CPPIB'

  on a.id_instrument_new = g.cppib_sec_id
left join
(
  select 
    CAST(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id,
    rating_value as issuer_final_rating
  FROM radar_reporting_prod.cppib_party_rating
  where cast(business_date as date) = date'2025-06-11'
    and rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
) as h
  on b.cppib_party_id_new = h.cppib_party_id

(
  select

     cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
     cppib_sector_classification_name_2,
     cppib_sector_classification_name_3,
     cppib_sector_classification_name_4
  FROM party.party_enterprise_classification
  where business_date = date'2025-06-11'
) as i
  on b.cppib_party_id_new = i.cppib_party_id

/* QuickSight 479fcb1b-19c1-4f44-a4fa-398f910cb45a */
SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

		, case

		, case
			when metric like '%_rc' then 'CAD'

		, case
			when metric like '%_qtd_%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%_3m_%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%_fytd_%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%_1y_roll_%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%_4yp_%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%_5y_roll_%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, node_name 
			, "level"
			, time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc

			, last_update 
		from 
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly

			dataset_id = 'ASSETCL_CMB'
			and periods_per_year = 12
			and "level" = 1
			and node_name != 'Excluded' -- Per Michael Brown from Performance team, the Excluded node should be excluded from reporting
	) pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc'

			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc'

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 20 and 21
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 20:16:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* QuickSight c39aac25-7446-488b-90d6-c67e9f2bf0dd */
SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

		, split_level

		, case

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd

			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc

					and scd.split_level = 1

				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2

			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'

			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency

			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:

	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

		from

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency

			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc

					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */

					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly

				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency

			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */

			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'

	cross join unnest (

			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'

	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.enterprise_security

	on shm.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
	and es.rn = 1
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by cppib_sec_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.asset_security_identifiers
) asi
	on shm.cppib_sec_id = cast(asi.cppib_sec_id as varchar(50))
	and asi.rn = 1

	on smp.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_model_portfolio)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
left join reference.scd_securities ss
	on ss.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_securities)
	and shm.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
left join (
	select *, 
	row_number() over(partition by portfolio_id order by business_date desc) latest
	from reference.scd_portfolio
) sp
	on sp.latest = 1
	and shm.portfolio_id = sp.portfolio_id

	on spif.business_date = (select max(business_date) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = spif.model_portfolio
	and spif.investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc
	on rcc.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
	and asi.incorp_country_code = rcc.country_code
left join reference.scd_securities ss_ul
	on cast(ss_ul.scd_security_key_id as varchar) = es.esm_underlying_instrument_id 
	and cast(ss_ul.business_date as date) = es.business_date
	and es.enterprise_security_source = 'SCD'
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_esm
	on rcc_esm.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
	and es.esm_country_code = rcc_esm.country_code
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country
	on rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
	and es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
left join reference.reference_exchange_codes rec
	on es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
	and es.mic = rec.mic
	and es.esm_exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'
	and rec.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_exchange_codes)
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country
	on rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
	and rcc_trade_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
left join (
	select *, 
	row_number() over(partition by id_instrument order by business_date desc) latest
	from trades_deals.irs_trades
) it
	on it.latest = 1
	and shm.abor_security_number = it.id_instrument ) ds LIMIT 0

/* cppi::cd14ad83ffcd8f0638fc41edebeadcedc1a3d68eac0001f19cba8f0b1f41165e */
with sbl_collateral_trades as
(
    select 
    extract_date, 
    business_date,
    trading_portfolio,
    custody_account_code,
    trade_id,
    deal_type as borrow_lend,
    instrument_sub_type,
    instrument_type,
    loan_account,
    maturity_date as sbl_maturity_date,
    counterparty_name,
    original_quantity,
    current_nominal_currency,
    current_nominal, 
    hair_cut_rate,
    id_underlying_instrument, 
    underlying_instrument_id_type, 
    id_underlying_instrument_source,
    underlying_instrument_name as Underlying_Ticker,
    fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,
    fx_rate_base_currency,
    underlying_current_price_currency,
    (case instrument_sub_type
    when 'Bonds Borrowing and Lending' 
    then current_quantity * (underlying_current_price/100) * underlying_currency_fx_rateto_cad * underlying_instrument_lot_size
    else current_quantity * underlying_current_price * underlying_currency_fx_rateto_cad * underlying_instrument_lot_size
    end) as mx_mv_cad
    from trades_deals.security_borrow_lending_collateral_trades
    where business_date = date'2025-06-11'
),
asset_equity as
(
    select 
    cppib_sec_id,
    isin, 
    instrument_name,
    bloomberg_unique_id, 
    type, 
    sub_type,
    null as maturity_date,
    business_date
    from asset.asset_equity
    where business_date = date'2025-06-11'
), 
asset_bonds as 
(
    select 
    cppib_sec_id,
    isin, 
    instrument_name,
    bloomberg_unique_id, 
    type, 
    sub_type,
    maturity_date,
    business_date
    from asset.asset_bonds
    where business_date = date'2025-06-11'
),
asset_warrants as 
(
    select 
    cppib_sec_id,
    isin, 
    instrument_name,
    bloomberg_unique_id, 
    type, 
    sub_type,
    null as maturity_date,
    business_date
    from asset.asset_warrants
    where business_date = date'2025-06-11'
),
asset_instrument_classifications as
(
    select
      cast(cppib_sec_id as varchar) as id_holding_decomposition,
      'CPPIBSEC_ID' holding_decomposition_id_type_code,
      security_type_id as "Security type",
      security_type_name as "Security type name",
      cppib_currency_of_exposure_code as currency_of_exposure_code,
--      cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
      business_date
    from cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite
    where business_date = date'2025-06-11'
    and esm_instrument_type = 'cppib_sec_id'
    and security_type_id is not null
),
murex_scd_model_portfolios_mapping as 
(
    select
    trading_portfolio_code,
    id_model_portfolio as model_portfolio
    from finance_accounting.murex_scd_model_portfolios_mapping
    where business_date = date'2025-06-11'
),
model_portfolios as
(
    select
    id_model_portfolio
    from finance_accounting.model_portfolios
    where business_date = date'2025-06-11'
),
asset_security_party_relationship as
(
    select
    cppib_sec_id,
    cppib_party_id,
    business_date
    from asset.asset_security_party_relationship
    where business_date = date'2025-06-11'
    and role = 'ISSUER'
),
party_enterprise_classification as
(
    select
    party_name as issuer_name,
    cppib_party_id,
    cppib_sector_classification_name_1 as GicsSector,
    cppib_sector_classification_code_1 as gics_sector_code,
    cppib_country_of_exposure_code as country_of_exposure_code,
    business_date
    from party.party_enterprise_classification
    where business_date = date'2025-06-11'
),
party_ratings as 
(
    select
    business_date,
    cppib_party_id, 
    rating_agency, 
    rating_value
    from risk_prod.cppib_party_rating
    where business_date = '2025-06-11'
    and rating_agency='CPPIB'
),
sbl_tbl as (
(
    select
    sbl_collateral_trades.*, 
    asset_equity.cppib_sec_id,
    asset_equity.isin, 
    asset_equity.instrument_name,
    asset_equity.bloomberg_unique_id, 
    asset_equity.type, 
    asset_equity.sub_type,
    asset_equity.maturity_date 
    from sbl_collateral_trades
    join asset_equity
    on sbl_collateral_trades.id_underlying_instrument_source = asset_equity.bloomberg_unique_id
)
union
(
    select 
    sbl_collateral_trades.*, 
    asset_bonds.cppib_sec_id,
    asset_bonds.isin, 
    asset_bonds.instrument_name,
    asset_bonds.bloomberg_unique_id, 
    asset_bonds.type, 
    asset_bonds.sub_type,
    asset_bonds.maturity_date
    from sbl_collateral_trades
    join asset_bonds
    on sbl_collateral_trades.id_underlying_instrument_source = asset_bonds.bloomberg_unique_id 
)
union
(
    select 
    sbl_collateral_trades.*, 
    asset_warrants.cppib_sec_id,
    asset_warrants.isin, 
    asset_warrants.instrument_name,
    asset_warrants.bloomberg_unique_id, 
    asset_warrants.type, 
    asset_warrants.sub_type,
    asset_warrants.maturity_date
    from sbl_collateral_trades
    join asset_warrants
    on sbl_collateral_trades.id_underlying_instrument_source = asset_warrants.bloomberg_unique_id 
))

select * from sbl_tbl
left join asset_instrument_classifications
on asset_instrument_classifications.id_holding_decomposition = cast(sbl_tbl.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
left join murex_scd_model_portfolios_mapping
on (murex_scd_model_portfolios_mapping.trading_portfolio_code = sbl_tbl.loan_account)
left join model_portfolios
on model_portfolios.id_model_portfolio = sbl_tbl.loan_account
left join asset_security_party_relationship
on asset_security_party_relationship.cppib_sec_id = sbl_tbl.cppib_sec_id
left join party_enterprise_classification
on party_enterprise_classification.cppib_party_id = asset_security_party_relationship.cppib_party_id
left join party_ratings
on party_ratings.cppib_party_id = asset_security_party_relationship.cppib_party_id

		when mp.pool_account_name = 'Supplementary Pool' then 'Supplementary'

) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-12')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-12')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_re_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_re_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency  AS "Total PnL QC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_start                         AS "Total Market Value PC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow PC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_end                           AS "Total Market Value PC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance_uat.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-06-12')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code

 FROM (

		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::1e0ea083293ec3350b9a9af93266fe8d3866cf27163228417d784460440c6f5f */
/* QuickSight 49008667-f54f-43ee-a0f3-2b5b102322a1 */
SELECT "business_date", "pool_name", "account_name", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "external_reporting_dm_em", "external_reporting_region", "external_reporting_country", "external_reporting_assetmix", "business_date_string", "year_month", "is_month_end", "is_fiscalyear_end", "external_reporting_dm_em_region", "external_reporting_currency", "total_market_value_pc"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'
			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)
select * from lt_final_agg) AS "finsights_holdings_lookthrough"

		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'
			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)
select * from lt_final_agg) AS "finsights_holdings_lookthrough"

 FROM (

		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 17 and 18
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 17:36:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 10 and 11
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 10:31:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

WITH 
	cred_exp_by_country AS
	  (
		SELECT
		  COALESCE(ref_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code) AS country,
		  parent.sovr_country_rating AS rating,
		  parent.sovr_country_outlook AS outlook,
		  GREATEST(0, SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(fact.credit_exposure, 0) ELSE 0 END )) AS tot_exposure,
		  parent.sovr_fi_limit AS tot_limit,
		  MAX( parent.region_fi_limit ) AS region_fi_limit
		FROM radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact 
		JOIN radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child ON fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		JOIN radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent ON child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		JOIN radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos ON fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
		LEFT JOIN radar_reporting_prod.ref_country ref_country ON ref_country.business_date = parent.business_date and parent.domicile_country_code = ref_country.alpha_2_code
		WHERE
		  fact.business_date='2025-06-11'
		  and fact.business_date = child.business_date
          and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
          and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
          and fact.business_date = ref_country.business_date
		  AND parent.sovr_fi_limit IS NOT NULL
		  AND ( parent.IS_FI IS NOT NULL OR child.IS_FI IS NOT NULL )
		  AND UPPER(pos.product_type) <> 'NETTING'
		GROUP BY
		  COALESCE(ref_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code),
		  parent.sovr_country_rating,
		  parent.sovr_country_outlook,
		  parent.sovr_fi_limit
	  )

	SELECT *
	FROM
	  (
		SELECT
		  country,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN tot_limit = -1 THEN 'OK'
		    WHEN (tot_exposure / COALESCE(GREATEST(tot_limit, 1), 1)) > 1 THEN 'BREACH'
		    ELSE 'OK'
		  END AS status,
		  rating,
		  outlook,
		  tot_exposure/1000000 AS tot_exposure,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN tot_limit = -1 THEN -1
			WHEN tot_limit = 0 THEN 0
			ELSE tot_limit / 1000000
		  END AS tot_limit,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN tot_limit = -1 THEN '-'
			WHEN tot_exposure > tot_limit THEN '0'
			ELSE format('%,.0f', truncate( ( tot_limit - GREATEST( 0, tot_exposure ) ) / 1000000))
		  END AS tot_avail,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN tot_limit = -1 OR tot_limit = 0 OR tot_limit IS NULL THEN 0
		  	ELSE ROUND( GREATEST( 0, tot_exposure / tot_limit * 100), 1)
		  END AS tot_usage
		FROM cred_exp_by_country
		UNION ALL
		SELECT
		  'Eurozone' AS country,
		  CASE
		    WHEN SUM( COALESCE( tot_exposure, 0 ) ) > region_fi_limit THEN 'BREACH'
		    ELSE 'OK'
		  END AS status,
		  '' AS rating,
		  '' AS outlook,
		  SUM( tot_exposure ) / 1000000 AS tot_exposure,
		  COALESCE( region_fi_limit / 1000000, 0 ) AS tot_limit,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN SUM( tot_exposure ) > region_fi_limit THEN '0'
			ELSE COALESCE( format('%,.0f', truncate( ( region_fi_limit - GREATEST( 0, SUM( tot_exposure ) ) ) / 1000000 ) ), '-' )
		  END AS tot_avail,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN region_fi_limit = 0 OR region_fi_limit IS NULL THEN 0
		  	ELSE ROUND( GREATEST( 0, SUM( tot_exposure ) / region_fi_limit * 100 ), 1 )
		  END AS tot_usage
		FROM cred_exp_by_country
		WHERE country IN ( 'France', 'Germany', 'Netherlands', 'Spain' )
		GROUP BY region_fi_limit
      ) c
    WHERE c.status <> 'OK'
	ORDER BY
	  CASE WHEN country = 'Eurozone' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
	  tot_exposure DESC

SELECT aaa.*, bbb.cppib_party_id 
FROM 
(
	SELECT  
		a.symbol_type_id,
		a.symbol_type_name, 
		a.symbol_value, 
		a.exchange_symbol as exchange_symbol2, 
		a.exchange_name, 
		a.tickersymbol,

		a.periodtypeid, 
		a.fiscalquarter, 
		a.companyname, 
		a.companyid, 
		a.pricingdate,
		a.marketcap, 
		a.totalenterprisevalue, 
		a.sharesoutstanding, 
		sum(a.totaldebtoverebitda) as totaldebtoverebitda,
		sum(a.totaldebt) as totaldebt, 
		a.calendaryear, 
		a.calendarquarter,
		a.fiscalyear
	FROM 
	(
		SELECT 
			st.symbol_type_id,
			st.symbol_type_name, 
			s.symbol_value, 
			ex.exchange_symbol as exchange_symbol2, 
			ex2.exchange_name, 
			ct.tickersymbol,
			ct.primaryflag, 
			ex2.exchange_symbol, 
			fd.periodtypeid, 
			fd.fiscalquarter, 
			c.companyname, 
			mc.companyid, 
			mc.pricingdate,
			mc.marketcap, 
			mc.tev as totalenterprisevalue, 
			mc.sharesoutstanding,
			case 
				when fd.dataitemid = 4192 then fd.dataitemvalue 
				else null end as totaldebtoverebitda,
			case 
				when fd.dataitemid = 4173 then fd.dataitemvalue 
				else null end as totaldebt,
			fd.calendaryear, 
			fd.calendarquarter, 
			fd.fiscalyear
		from party.capiq_company c
		join (
			select
				fp.companyid, fp.periodtypeid, fp.fiscalquarter, fp.calendaryear, fp.calendarquarter, fp.fiscalyear,
				ic.financialinstanceid, fd.dataitemvalue, fd.financialcollectionid, fd.dataitemid,
				rank() over (partition by fp.companyid, fd.dataitemid order by fi.filingdate desc) rank
		    from party.capiq_ciqfinperiod fp 
    		join party.capiq_ciqfininstance fi 
			    on fi.financialperiodid = fp.financialperiodid
			join party.capiq_ciqfininstancetocollection ic 
			    on ic.financialinstanceid = fi.financialinstanceid 
			join party.capiq_ciqfincollectiondata fd 
				on fd.financialcollectionid = ic.financialcollectionid
			where
			    fp.periodtypeid = 4 		
			    and fp.latestperiodflag = 1
				and fi.latestfilingforinstanceflag = 1
				and fd.dataitemid in (4192, 4173)  -- 4173 = 'Total Debt' | 4192 = 'Total Debt / EBITDA'

		join party.capiq_ciqsymbol s

		join party.capiq_ciqmarketcap mc

		left join party.capiq_exchange ex

		left join party.capiq_ciqtradingitem ct
			on st.symbol_type_id in (3,4,13,14) and s.object_id = ct.securityid and ct.primaryflag = 1
		join party.capiq_exchange ex2
			on ct.exchangeid = ex2.exchange_id
		where
			s.symbol_type_id in (3,4,13,14)
			and s.symbol_value is not null
			and s.active_flag = 1
			and s.symbol_end_date is null
	) as a

		a.symbol_type_id, a.symbol_type_name, a.symbol_value, a.exchange_symbol, a.exchange_name, a.tickersymbol,
		a.primaryflag, a.periodtypeid,
		a.fiscalquarter, a.companyname, a.companyid, a.pricingdate,
		a.marketcap, a.totalenterprisevalue, a.sharesoutstanding,
		a.calendaryear, a.calendarquarter, a.fiscalyear

/* cppi::f63b50a49ce182630558c1225200f242979038d9777e5df007d50d6b73d51093 */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 06 and 07
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 06:16:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

        sec.abor_instrument_type_id AS instrument_type_name,

select 
current_date as extractDate,
current_timestamp as extractTime,
scdh.business_date as businessDate,
(cast(smp.scd_model_portfolio_primary_key as varchar)  || (case
	when mhl.parent_cppib_sec_id not in ( 'Not Applicable' , 'Error') then 'CPPIBSEC_ID'
	else 'TRADE_REF'
end) || case
	when mhl.parent_cppib_sec_id not in ( 'Not Applicable' , 'Error') then mhl.parent_cppib_sec_id
	else cast(scdh.abor_security_number as varchar) 
end ) as ID_enterpriseHolding,
scdh.portfolio_id as ID_portfolio,
mhl.id_model_portfolio as ID_modelPortfolio,
cast(scdh.abor_security_number as varchar) as ID_instrument, 
'TRADE_REF' as instrumentIDType, 
case
	when mhl.cppib_sec_id not in ( 'Not Applicable' , 'Error') then mhl.cppib_sec_id
	else cast(scdh.abor_security_number as varchar)
end as ID_holdingDecomposition,
case
	when mhl.cppib_sec_id  not in ( 'Not Applicable' , 'Error') then 'CPPIBSEC_ID' 
	else 'SECURITY_NO'
end as holdingDecompositionIDTypeCode, 
scdh.scd_holding_key_id as TBT_HOLDINGKEY,
NULL as INSTRUMENTGROUPCODE,
scdh.abor_instrument_type as INSTRUMENTGROUPNAME,
scdh.security_group_id as INSTRUMENTSUBGROUPCODE,
scdh.security_group_name as INSTRUMENTSUBGROUPNAME,
scdh.abor_security_type_id as INSTRUMENTTYPECODE,
scdh.abor_security_type_name as INSTRUMENTTYPENAME,
scdh.abor_security_name as INSTRUMENTNAMESOURCE,
(case when mhl.holding_level = 'Top Level' then scdh.abor_security_name else mhl.security_name end) as underlyingInstrumentNameSource,
(case when mhl.holding_level = 'Top Level' then scdh.abor_security_type_id 
      when mhl.holding_level <> 'Look Through' then NULL
--      else COALESCE(scds2.abor_security_type_id,COALESCE(mhl.security_type_name,scds.abor_security_type_id)) end) as underlyingInstrumentTypeCode,
      else COALESCE(scds3.abor_security_type_id,COALESCE(scds2.scd_sec_type,COALESCE(mhl.security_type_name,scds.abor_security_type_id))) end) as underlyingInstrumentTypeCode,
scdh.balance_nominal_number as quantity,
scdh.clean_price as currentPrice,
mhl.balance_nominal as underlyingQuantity,
COALESCE(mdsprice.current_price,abs(case when COALESCE(mhl.balance_nominal,0) = 0  then null
      when mhl.holding_level = 'Look Through' then round(mhl.total_market_value_qc/mhl.balance_nominal,6) 
      else null end)) as underlyingPrice,
(sum(case when leg_no = 1 and holding_level = 'Look Through' then mhl.total_market_value_qc else 0 end) over(partition by scdh.scd_holding_key_id)) as marketValue,
scdh.quotation_currency_code as quotedCurrencyCode,
scdh.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as fxRateQuotedInCAD,
(sum(case when mhl.leg_no = 1 and holding_level = 'Look Through' then mhl.total_market_value_pc else 0 end) over(partition by scdh.scd_holding_key_id)) as marketValuePC,
'CAD' as portfoliocurrencyCode,
0 as faceValue,
NULL as optionDelta,
(case when mhl.holding_level = 'Top Level' or mhl.underlying_index_name in ( 'Not Applicable' , 'Error') then NULL 
		else mhl.underlying_index_name end) as referenceIndex,
upper(mhl.holding_level) as lookthroughLevelType,
abs(case when mhl.holding_level = 'Top Level' THEN 1
           when mhl.holding_level = 'Look Through' and --mhl.leg_no = 1 and 
           (sum(case when leg_no = 1 and holding_level = 'Look Through' then mhl.total_market_value_qc else 0 end) over(partition by scdh.scd_holding_key_id) ) <> 0
           then
              mhl.total_market_value_qc/(sum(case when leg_no = 1 and holding_level = 'Look Through' then mhl.total_market_value_qc else 0 end) over(partition by scdh.scd_holding_key_id) )
           else null end)  as  underlyingWeight
from holdings_qa.scd_holdings_main scdh
join reference_qa.scd_model_portfolio smp on smp.business_date  = scdh.business_date  and smp.model_portfolio_id = scdh.model_portfolio_id 
join holdings_qa.ma_holding_lookthrough_extended mhl on  mhl.business_Date  = cast(scdh.business_Date as date) and scdh.scd_holding_key_id = mhl.parent_holding_key
left outer join reference_qa.scd_securities scds on scdh.business_Date = scds.business_Date and scdh.abor_security_number =  scds.abor_security_number
left outer join reference_qa.scd_securities scds3 on scdh.business_Date = scds3.business_Date and  cast(mhl.cppib_sec_id as varchar) =  scds3.cppib_sec_id
left outer join asset_qa.asset_security_identifiers scds2 on mhl.business_Date  = scds2.business_Date and  mhl.cppib_sec_id =  cast(scds2.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
left outer join mdsprice on mhl.cppib_sec_id = cast(mdsprice.cppib_sec_id as varchar) and trim(upper(mdsprice.currency_code)) = trim(upper(scdh.quotation_currency_code))
--left outer join indxconstprice on mhl.cppib_sec_id = cast(indxconstprice.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
where scdh.business_Date = '2025-06-11'  
and portfolio_calculation_id = 'RISK METRICS_DAILY'
and portfolio_group_id = 'CPPIB GROUP'
and upper(trim(scdh.abor_security_type_id)) in ('TRSEQIC', 'TRSILB', 'TRSFIIC', 'TRSEQ') 
and /* exclude zero-balance holdings */
NOT
(
COALESCE(scdh.clean_value_quotation_currency,0) = 0 and
COALESCE(scdh.balance_nominal_number,0) =0 and
COALESCE(scdh.accrued_interest_quotation_currency,0) = 0 and
COALESCE(scdh.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency,0) = 0 and
COALESCE(scdh.next_dividend_quotation_currency,0) = 0 and
COALESCE(scdh.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency,0) = 0 and
COALESCE(scdh.balance_nominal_number_unsettled,0) = 0 and
COALESCE(scdh.next_coupon_quotation_currency,0) = 0 
)
order by scdh.scd_holding_key_id

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 16 and 17
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 16:50:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000
